exceptions.reason: Its modules re-export the d3 packages, which are bundled and noticed as entries of their own; it ships no licence file for its shim, and Recharts needs it. Its source is named in its entry.

It declares MIT in its package.json and its readme, and ships no licence file; remarkjs/remark-math, its repository, which its entry names, holds the licence. Markdown's math needs it (portalr ADR-0044).
